results.name: Wildfire in the Slavyanka Mountain, Bulgaria and Greece
results.reason: On 24 July 2024, a wildfire was located over a border area between Bulgaria and Greece, in the Slavyanka Mountain, a difficult-to-access mountainous terrain above 2 000 meters with hazard linked to an old minefield. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide wildfire extent mapping and monitoring.
